description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the DataSetRepository class in the Goteo project. It tests the CRUD operations and exception handling related to DataSet entities.

classes.name: DataSetRepositoryTest
classes.description: Test suite for the DataSetRepository class, covering CRUD operations, exception handling, and data integrity checks.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and creates an instance of DataSetRepository.

methods.name: testExceptionOnGetById
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving a non-existent DataSet throws a ModelNotFoundException.

methods.name: testGetList
methods.description: Checks that getList returns an array and initially contains zero DataSet objects.

methods.name: testPersistDataSet
methods.description: Creates and persists a new DataSet, then verifies the count of DataSets in the repository.

methods.name: testDataSetExists
methods.description: Ensures a persisted DataSet can be retrieved and matches the original data.

methods.name: testUpdateDataSet
methods.description: Updates the title of an existing DataSet, persists the change, and verifies the update.

methods.name: testDeleteDataSet
methods.description: Deletes an existing DataSet and confirms that the repository is empty afterward.
